info.title: NutriAI API - SwappFit Integration Service
info.description:
Production-ready OpenAPI 3.0 REST API specification for NutriAI microservice backend integrated with SwappFit.

## Rate limits and AI protection

NutriAI fronts its AI provider with two shared controls that are already enforced: a per-user rate limiter and a single global concurrency and queue controller. This section documents the behaviour a client can actually observe.

### Rate limits

Each limit is a sliding 60-second window keyed on the authenticated user id. The window is held in process memory, so it applies per running instance and resets when the service restarts.

| Endpoint | Limit per 60 s | Behaviour when the limit is reached |
| --- | --- | --- |
| POST /api/food-recognize | 10 | `429` with code `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` |
| POST /api/voice-log/parse | 15 | `429` with code `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` |
| POST /api/chat | 25 | `200` with a generic holding reply. No error is returned |
| GET /api/recommendations | 20 | `200` computed by deterministic scoring instead of the AI. No error is returned |

Limits are counted per user session, not per IP address. No `X-RateLimit-*` or `Retry-After` headers are sent, so a throttled client must detect the condition from the status code or the response body.

### Concurrency and queueing

Every AI request passes through one global controller, so a slow request on any AI route holds a slot against all other AI routes.

| Setting | Default | Environment variable |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Concurrent AI requests | 2 | `AI_MAX_CONCURRENCY` |
| Queued AI requests | 10 | `AI_MAX_QUEUE_SIZE` |

Once the queue is full, further AI work is rejected with the internal code `AI_BUSY`. Clients observe this as `503` on POST /api/food-recognize and as `504` with code `AI_TIMEOUT` on the meal-plan generation endpoints. A provider timeout and a full queue raise the same code, so a `504` does not distinguish between them. Live telemetry for this controller is available from GET /api/v1/internal/ai-health.

### Timeouts

AI requests are aborted after a fixed timeout: 15 seconds for food recognition and 10 seconds for recommendations. There is no automatic retry, no backoff, and no circuit breaker, so a timeout is reported to the caller rather than retried.

### Automatic fallbacks

Some routes degrade to a non-AI result and still return `200`, so a caller cannot tell a fallback from a live AI result except where noted.

| Endpoint | Fallback |
| --- | --- |
| POST /api/voice-log/parse | Offline text parser. The response shape is unchanged and `data.parser` is `fallback` instead of `ai` |
| GET /api/recommendations | Deterministic scoring against the meal database |
| GET /api/nutrition/hydration-analysis | Rule-based hydration message |
| POST /api/chat | Static holding reply |

post.description:
Accepts a text transcript from a voice meal input and converts it into structured meal/food candidates.

### Text, not audio

**POST /api/voice-log/parse accepts text, not audio.** The request body is JSON with a single `text` field. There is no audio upload, no `multipart/form-data`, and no transcription field. Speech-to-text is entirely the caller's responsibility. Local Whisper (Transformers.js) is a client-side implementation choice inside the SwappFit app, not a NutriAI API, and is not part of this specification.

The endpoint uses the same food-resolution and nutrition system as photo-based food recognition. It returns candidates only — nothing is logged until you call POST /api/food-recognize/confirm followed by POST /api/food-logs.

Text is interpreted as spoken language and is expected to tolerate ASR errors (e.g. "italy and amber for breakfast" is resolved to idli + sambar). Foods are never invented: only foods present in the text are returned. Max 8 items per request.

Authentication uses the same user session as the rest of the API (bearer session token or `session` cookie), not a service token.

### Limits and protections

| Protection | Limit |
| --- | --- |
| Rate limit | 15 requests / 60 s per user |
| Transcript length | 1,000 characters |
| Items per request | 8 |
| Food matching | Exact name or alias match only — the engine never substitutes a different database dish for the food you stated |

Checks run in this order, so a rate-limited caller receives `429` even when the body is also invalid: `401` session, then `429` rate limit, then `400` body.

### SwappFit Voice Meal Integration

Voice logging is split between two parties: SwappFit owns the audio, NutriAI owns food understanding.

| Step | Owner | Detail |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Microphone capture | SwappFit | Audio never reaches NutriAI and is never stored |
| Speech-to-text | SwappFit | Any STT provider; NutriAI does not verify the origin of the text |
| Transcript delivery | SwappFit to NutriAI | POST /api/voice-log/parse with a JSON `text` field |
| Food understanding and ASR-error correction | NutriAI | Gemma 3 4B recovers the food the user intended |
| Food resolution and DB nutrition match | NutriAI | Nutrition DB match, then stored custom food, then ingredient composition, then AI recipe-ingredient fallback |
| Portion confirmation | User, in the SwappFit UI | Candidates are returned; nothing is logged yet |
| Logging | SwappFit to NutriAI | POST /api/food-recognize/confirm, then POST /api/food-logs |

NutriAI does not let AI generate nutrition numbers. When a food is not in the database, the AI extracts the recipe ingredients, then NutriAI composes the nutrition values from its own Ingredient table.

#### Flow: request, response, confirmation, logging

| Step | Call | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | POST /api/voice-log/parse | Send the transcript, receive food candidates |
| 2 | none | The user confirms the food and the portion |
| 3 | POST /api/food-recognize/confirm | Resolve the portion and compute final nutrition |
| 4 | POST /api/food-logs | Log the item to the meal slot |

#### Worked example

Transcript: `I ate puttu kadala for breakfast`.

**1. Request**

```json
{ "text": "I ate puttu kadala for breakfast" }
```

**2. Response (abbreviated)**

`data.draft` reports `mealType: "breakfast"`, the hint for which meal slot to pre-select. One food candidate is returned with `portionType: "portion"`, `portionOptions` of Small 150 g, Medium 225 g, Full 300 g (default) and More, `nutritionSource: "extracted"`, `estimatedNutrition` populated, and `matched: false` with `mealId: null` because the dish is not in the database. Nothing has been logged yet.

**3. Confirmation (the user picked Full Plate)**

```json
POST /api/food-recognize/confirm
{ "name": "Puttu kadala", "portionType": "portion", "totalGrams": 300, "portionValue": 300, "unit": "g", "ingredients": [{ "name": "Rice flour", "grams": 120 }, { "name": "Black gram", "grams": 60 }, { "name": "Chickpeas", "grams": 90 }] }
```

The response contains `grams: 300`, the final `nutrition` block, and a `mealId`. A meal row is created so the same dish is recognised next time.

**4. Logging**

```json
POST /api/food-logs
{ "mealId": "meal_abc123", "servingGms": 300, "mealSlot": "breakfast", "source": "voice" }
```

#### Two logging branches

POST /api/food-logs takes a different body depending on what the confirmation returned.

When the confirm response contains a `mealId` (a Nutrition DB meal, or a meal created during confirmation), NutriAI scales the stored nutrition for you:

```json
{ "mealId": "meal_abc123", "servingGms": 300, "mealSlot": "breakfast", "source": "voice" }
```

When the confirm response has `mealId: null` (nutrition was reused from a stored unknown-food submission), you must send the nutrition values inline:

```json
{ "name": "Puttu kadala", "servingGms": 300, "calories": 320, "proteinG": 9.4, "carbsG": 48.2, "fatG": 8.1, "fiberG": 6.5, "sugarG": 1.2, "sodiumMg": 520, "mealSlot": "breakfast", "source": "voice" }
```

### Shared resolution

Photo and voice call the same food-resolution engine: Nutrition DB match, stored custom-food reuse, ingredient composition, AI recipe-ingredient fallback, followed by portion options and scaled nutrition. Confirmation (POST /api/food-recognize/confirm) and logging (POST /api/food-logs with `source: "voice"`) are also shared with photo. Only the input stage differs.

get.summary: AI concurrency telemetry, recent AI call metrics, and manual cleanup
get.description:
Returns live telemetry for the global AI concurrency and queue controller, plus aggregate metrics from the AI call log. Two optional query parameters mutate server state: `setConcurrency` changes the process-wide concurrency ceiling and `cleanup` deletes stale temporary uploads, so this endpoint should only be called by operators.

Authentication: this endpoint uses a **user session** (bearer session token or `session` cookie), not the service token used by the other `/api/v1/internal/` routes. It inherits the API-wide security requirement.

The `status` field is a fixed literal and does not reflect live AI provider reachability; use `metrics` and `concurrency` for actual conditions.

parameters.name: setConcurrency
parameters.description: Sets the process-wide maximum number of concurrent AI requests. Values outside 1-10 are ignored and leave the current setting unchanged.

parameters.name: cleanup
parameters.description: When `true`, deletes stale temporary upload files and returns the outcome in `data.cleanupResult`. Otherwise this field is null.

200.description: Concurrency telemetry, recent AI call metrics, and optional cleanup result

401.description: No valid user session (missing or invalid bearer token, or missing session cookie)

example.error: Failed to retrieve AI health telemetry

serviceToken.description: Service JWT signed with INTERNAL_SERVICE_SECRET (issuer 'swapp-backend', audience 'nutriai-service'). The 'sub' claim is the SwappFit user id.

InternalProfileUpdate.description: Payload to create/update an integrated user's nutrition profile, goal, and preferences.

macroOverrideJson.description: Optional JSON string overriding default macro percentages

FoodConfirmRequest.description: Payload to confirm a food portion and resolve scaled nutrition prior to logging.

portionValue.description: The amount in the specified unit.

mealId.description: Database meal ID if matched to master DB.

newFoodId.description: Stored unknown food ID if reusing previous custom submission.

tempImagePath.description: Temporary upload path returned by photo recognition to persist image.

ingredients.description: Recipe ingredients list used for local nutrition composition when food is not in master DB.

gramsPerPiece.description: Weight per piece in grams (required when unit is 'pc').

VoiceParseRequest.description: A text transcript produced by the caller's own speech-to-text step. The origin of the text is not verified: typed input, a third-party STT provider, or a transcribed webhook are all accepted equally.

text.description: Plain-text meal description, e.g. the output of a speech-to-text step. This endpoint accepts text only and never accepts audio.
text.example: I ate puttu kadala for breakfast

foods.description: Resolved food candidates ready for portion confirmation. Never empty: a transcript with no recognisable food returns 422 instead.

parser.description: Which food-understanding step produced the draft. 'ai' = the Gemma recognition model. 'fallback' = the conservative offline text parser used when the AI server is unreachable. Both feed the identical shared food-resolution engine, so the resulting candidates are comparable.

MealLogDraft.description: Input-neutral handoff from the food-understanding step to the portion-confirmation step. Returned for display and slot pre-selection; the authoritative resolution is in the parallel foods array.

mealType.description: The meal slot the user actually mentioned. Omitted when no slot was spoken; the client chooses a default.

foodName.description: The corrected, plain food name, after ASR error correction. No adjectives, no sauces, and no embedded counts.

quantity.description: The stated amount, or null when none was spoken.

unit.description: The stated unit, lowercased. Typical values: piece, bowl, glass, plate, cup, serving, grams, ml.

portionSpecified.description: True only when the user actually stated an amount or portion.

confidence.description: Confidence in the interpreted food name after ASR error correction. Higher means more certain.

portionType.description: The food's natural portion unit, chosen from food knowledge independently of whether an amount was spoken. Null lets the shared classifier decide.

RecognizedFood.description: One resolved food candidate. Returned identically by photo recognition (POST /api/food-recognize) and voice parsing (POST /api/voice-log/parse); the two inputs differ only in the stage that produced the food.

name.description: The food's plain name as understood, after ASR correction where applicable.

servingDescription.description: How the amount was served, e.g. '2 pc'. Empty when the user stated no amount.

portionType.description: How this food is naturally measured.

estimatedGrams.description: Estimated weight in grams. Null for drink-portion foods; see estimatedMl.

estimatedMl.description: Estimated volume in millilitres. Set only for drink-portion foods.

estimatedPieces.description: Estimated count. Set only for piece-portion foods.

gramsPerPiece.description: Weight of a single piece. Set only for piece-portion foods.

totalGrams.description: The grams the estimates resolve to, and the basis used for scaling nutrition.

needsConfirmation.description: True when the exact dish is ambiguous or confidence is low. Voice input always requires confirmation.

variants.description: Plausible specific variants, offered when needsConfirmation is true. Always empty for voice input.

nutritionSource.description: Where the nutrition came from. 'meal' = a Nutrition DB meal row. 'ingredients' = composed from the Ingredient table. 'extracted' = the AI extracted the recipe ingredients, which were then composed locally. 'stored' = reused from a previously submitted unknown food.

portionOptions.description: Portion choices to present for confirmation. Voice input uses natural units (glasses, plates, fixed gram levels) and marks the option matching the spoken amount as default; photo input uses the standard option set.

estimatedNutrition.description: Nutrition for the estimated portion, or null when no nutrition could be composed. The user can still confirm and enter it manually.

ingredients.description: The ingredients used to compose nutrition, with per-ingredient match status.

matched.description: True when the food resolved to a Nutrition DB meal.

unknown_food.description: True when the food is not in the Nutrition DB.

meal.description: The matched Nutrition DB meal, or null when the food is unknown.

mealId.description: Pass as mealId to POST /api/food-recognize/confirm to log against the DB meal.

newFoodId.description: Set when nutrition was reused from a stored unknown-food submission. Pass as newFoodId to POST /api/food-recognize/confirm.

RecognizedFoodVariant.description: A candidate specific dish offered when a food's identity is ambiguous.

matched.description: True when this variant resolved to a Nutrition DB meal.

meal.description: The matched Nutrition DB meal for this variant, or null.

estimatedNutrition.description: Nutrition for this variant at the resolved portion, or null.

RecognizedIngredient.description: One ingredient considered when composing nutrition for a food.

grams.description: Weight of this ingredient in the resolved portion.

matched.description: False when the ingredient was not found in the master Ingredient table. Unmatched entries do not contribute to the total.

PortionOption.description: A portion choice presented for confirmation. Exactly one preset option carries default: true, and for voice input it is the option closest to the amount the user actually spoke.

label.description: Display label shown to the user.

value.description: The amount in the given unit. Zero when kind is 'custom', meaning the user should enter their own amount.

kind.description: 'preset' = a selectable amount. 'custom' = the 'More' escape hatch where the user types an amount.

ScaledNutrition.description: Nutrition for a resolved portion, scaled from per-100 g database values. NutriAI always computes these numbers itself; they are never generated by AI.

MealSummary.description: The matched Nutrition DB meal. This is the full meal record and it carries additional properties; do not depend on any field beyond id and name.
